title: This is used in interest calculations to determine interest
raw_text:
9/30/26, 5:12 AM

e That all items posted to the account receive a clearing
restriction

This has the effect that these items can only be cleared by
specific business transactions (for example, year-end
settlement in a utilities company)

e The tolerance limits that apply to outstanding payments
e The underlying clearing category for clearing postings

e The planning group that the business partner belongs to
and how many additional days are taken into consideration
before an open item is paid (cash management)

e That an interest key applies at contract account level

This is used in interest calculations to determine interest
frequency, amount limits and transfer and tolerance days
as long as no other interest key has been defined at a more
specific level.

Outgoing Payments                                                                         e That payments are processed using an alternative payer or

alternative payee

e Which bank details are used for incoming and outgoing
payments

e Which card ID is valid for incoming and outgoing payments
e Which mandate applies for incoming payments

e The reason for locking the contract account for incoming or
outgoing payments

Several limited-time locks are possible.

Payments/Taxes: Taxes
e That the withholding tax code is set for incoming and

outgoing payments in the relevant country

That several characteristics are defined for each tax code,
such as the tax rate
